checked_boundaries: All other external import crate roots exist in original Agentd dependencies/dev-dependencies; own library and support modules are reachable.
Agentd root exports AutomationEffectObservation/ReconcileState; execute_effect and reconcile_effect are public async methods with matching arguments.
Agent protocol snapshots expose the accessed fields and derive Clone/Eq/PartialEq/Serialize; both compared terminal receipt_digest fields are Option<Sha256Digest>.

AutomationStore open/close, authorized attempt/terminal reads, prepare/claim operations and TaskFlow constructors are public with matching arity and types; TaskFlowError/AuthorizedEffectError support anyhow conversion.
ProviderEffectIntent::new returns Self; ProviderEffectKey::for_taskflow_v2 is a public inherent method, despite residing in a private implementation module.
HttpProviderEffectConfig and contract_sha256 plus HttpProviderEffectContractAttestation::statement_for_pq are public; String error is explicitly mapped to anyhow.
Supervisor exposes event/snapshot types and kill/tick/snapshot methods; ProcessExit is Copy, allowing the borrowed-event pattern used by find_map.
Fleet delta adds a pub(crate) method within the integration-test crate, preserving original recovery arguments and calling the public AgentCommand/Supervisor API.
PQ key/signature/Unix endpoint/FinalUse APIs and error conversions were cross-checked by w1_audit; capacity.used_nonces is usize.
PqTrustOperationV2 has five variants and no non_exhaustive marker; the new external integration service match covers all role/variant cases.
The timeout(..., JoinHandle).await??.is_err() expression unwraps elapsed/join errors and tests the remaining Agentd Result; its nested Result shape matches the call.
